reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound in principle, as ML surrogates trained on static ab initio data have been successfully used for free energies, but it lacks specific details on how the surrogate will capture liquid-phase configurational entropy and dynamic anharmonicity without MD, which are major gaps.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (error >5% or <50% speedup), but it is incomplete because it does not specify how the 'static ab initio free-energy evaluations' will be generated for the liquid phase, making the benchmark impractical as written.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses the core problem of cost reduction for fusion properties in high-entropy systems and proposes a plausible direction, but its lack of specificity on the liquid-phase surrogate makes it only moderately useful as a direct guide for implementation.
